:::intro{robot="anatomy" title="Look closer, when you want to"}
This page takes the toggle apart to show how design decisions become the parts you see. You don't need it to use the toggle: [its own page](../toggle) has everything you need to build.

**Three easy ways in**

- Start with the drawing. Each number is one part, and the legend beside it names it.
- Want to know why a part looks the way it does? Its card follows the decision from the answer about the product, through the rule and the token, to what you see.
- Or start from a job, like Focus or Emphasis, and find every part that does it in the legend.

Come back whenever a part makes you wonder why.
:::

## Design roles

Each part does a job for the person. These are the jobs, as questions the part answers.

<div class="odv-am-rolelist"><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Containment</b> What holds this?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Layering</b> What sits on top?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Hierarchy</b> What do you read first?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Readability</b> Can you read it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Emphasis</b> Where does the eye go?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Meaning</b> What state is it in?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Affordance</b> Can you act on it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Feedback</b> Did it respond?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Focus</b> Where is the keyboard?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Grouping</b> What belongs together?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Reach</b> Can you hit it?</span></div>

## How the decisions reach each part

Each part follows a chain: an answer about the product, the rule it set, the token that carries it, and the value you see. The numbers match the drawing.

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-1"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/accessible-first/toggle/card-1.png" alt="Body: 1" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">1</i><b>Body</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you act on it?">Affordance</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you hit it?">Reach</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Shape · What should control corners say? → Slightly rounded</div><div class="odv-am-why">Clear, slightly rounded controls.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · What is the smallest target? → Large</div><div class="odv-am-why">Large targets for tremor and touch.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Spacing · How dense is the layout? → Spacious</div><div class="odv-am-why">Space lowers effort and mis-taps.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For corners of buttons and inputs, use radius.control. Don't use a pill.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Clear rectangles read as fields and buttons.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For the smallest clickable thing, use size.control.default (large). Don't use touch-minimum size.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Large targets help people with motor needs.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>radius.control</code><span>→</span><code>radius</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.375rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> radius.6: Clear, slightly rounded controls.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>component-spacing-map.x2</code><span>→</span><code>default.padding-x</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.5rem</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.8</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-2"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/accessible-first/toggle/card-2.png" alt="Label: 2" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">2</i><b>Label</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you read it?">Readability</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Typography · Which text roles does it need? → Core: heading, body, label</div><div class="odv-am-why">Few roles keep pages predictable.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.text.primary</code><span>→</span><code>label</code><span class="odv-am-val">#141414 · dark #F7F7F7</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">Body text and headings.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.900: the strongest text step, 18.42:1 on surface.default, above the 7:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.2:1 on surface.default, above the 7:1 floor.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> surface.inverse. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.text.primary.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.body.font-size</code><span>→</span><code>font-size</code><span class="odv-am-val">1.1875rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> font.size.19</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.label.font-weight</code><span>→</span><code>font-weight</code><span class="odv-am-val">700</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> font.weight.700</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-3"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/accessible-first/toggle/card-3.png" alt="On: 3" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">3</i><b>On</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What state is it in?">Meaning</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="Did it respond?">Feedback</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · How many signals carry each meaning? → Three: color, icon and word</div><div class="odv-am-why">Never color alone.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · Which states get their own visible value? → All, including loading</div><div class="odv-am-why">Every state, including loading, gets its own value.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For a selected row or item, use color.surface.selected and a check icon. Don't use color alone.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Selection never relies on color alone.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.selected</code><span>→</span><code>background.on</code><span class="odv-am-val">#E2EDFF · dark #102547</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The fill of a selected or current item, or a toggle that is on.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> blue.light.100: a tint of the brand, 1.18:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.</div><div><b>Dark</b> blue.dark.100: a tint of the brand, 1.21:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> category.1.subtle. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.selected.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.border.selected</code><span>→</span><code>edge.on</code><span class="odv-am-val">#0B4FC0 · dark #8AB4F8</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The edge that marks a selected item, beside its fill, so selection is never color alone.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> blue.light.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 7.26:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> blue.dark.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 8.74:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> border.focus, action.primary, category.1. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.border.selected.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>border-width.default</code><span>→</span><code>edge-width.on</code><span class="odv-am-val">2px</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> border-width.2</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-4"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/accessible-first/toggle/card-4.png" alt="Hover fill: 4" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">4</i><b>Hover fill</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Did it respond?">Feedback</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · Which states get their own visible value? → All, including loading</div><div class="odv-am-why">Every state, including loading, gets its own value.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Motion · How fast does feedback feel? → Moderate</div><div class="odv-am-why">Moderate speed is easy to follow.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For hover and press feedback, use motion.duration.feedback (moderate). Don't use fast flicker.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Moderate speed is easy to follow.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.highlight</code><span>→</span><code>background.hover</code><span class="odv-am-val">#EDEDED · dark #222222</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The fill of the item the pointer or the keyboard is on, or whose submenu is open. A state shows on the item's background, one step from the surface it sits on: darker in light, lighter in dark.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.100, two steps darker than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.0), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band without lifting off the page. It skips neutral.50, the page canvas, so a menu item never matches the page behind it.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.100, one step lighter than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.50), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band on the menu and on cards.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> surface.sunken, action.secondary.hover, category.5.subtle, disabled.surface. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.highlight.</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-5"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/accessible-first/toggle/card-5.png" alt="Focus ring: 5" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">5</i><b>Focus ring</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Where is the keyboard?">Focus</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · What contrast floor do we hold? → AAA for text</div><div class="odv-am-why">AAA contrast for text.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For keyboard focus, use button/focus-ring at border-width.focus, with an offset. Don't use a thin or faint outline.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Focus must be seen by everyone.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>border-width.focus</code><span>→</span><code>focus</code><span class="odv-am-val">3px</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. ## For agents

Agents get this same anatomy: every part, its roles, whether it is required, the tokens it reads and the decisions behind them.

- **From an AI agent:** call the `get_anatomy` tool on the Open DS MCP server, with this scheme and `toggle`.
- **From a terminal:** `npx open-ds anatomy accessible-first toggle`
